question_text: Construct an ERD for members, access cards and borrowed devices. Each member has zero or one card; each card belongs to exactly one member. A member may borrow many devices; each device is currently assigned to zero or one member. Show cardinalities and optionality.
adaptation_rationale: ERD cardinality/modality explicitly scoped. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: MEMBER1—0..1CARD; MEMBER0..1—0..many DEVICE, with card/member and device/member directions labelled as specified.
